title: Three-step guided intake with minimum-detail validation

Every tag in the shipped seed data is still a member of both enums. Req 10 / AC: Sprint 2's two test files are entirely UNMODIFIED -- not merely "unmodified except for the rename." No other domain type changes shape. Not a FAIL. AC: no locally declared domain type anywhere in the diff. The two local declarations are `type Step = 1|2|3` (UI state) and `ValidationResult` (a mechanism result shape, the same class as Sprint 2's CitationGuardResult, which passed). No Pick<>/Omit<> anywhere. AC: no intake component references a legal fact pattern -- grepped app/ and components/ for all four legal values and for FactPatternTag. Zero hits. The bridge is left to Sprints 4 and 5, as required. Req 2/3/4: all specified fields and all three distinct narrative prompts present.
